title: Work order lines are read-only when Create & Edit is OFF
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View and Work order lines Create & Edit OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order.
  2. Look at the lines; try to edit fields and to add a new line.
custom_expected:
There is no Add line option.

Existing line fields are read-only.
evidence: UI (WO View only, no WOL Create&Edit): no Add line option and existing line fields are read-only (no New Line, no edit affordances). screenshot wol-tcuLines.
